digest: glowing orb or disc, dusk sun or crescent, lens streak or sheen band, accent bar or rule line, the same seam move twice, three directions in one material, a finance tool as the invented product
list: A glowing circle, orb or disc as the hero, above all a flat disc with no light source.
A dusk sun or a crescent, and the name Vesper or a similar light-poetry name.
Lens streaks, light-beam or sheen-band sweeps; accent bars and rule lines under a word.
A finance, invoice or accounts tool as the invented product.
